question:
Study the table below showing the marks obtained by six students in five subjects (out of 100) and answer the question.

Student | Math | Science | English | History | Geography
Amit | 75 | 80 | 65 | 70 | 85
Bela | 90 | 85 | 80 | 75 | 90
Chetan | 60 | 70 | 75 | 65 | 80
Divya | 85 | 90 | 95 | 80 | 85
Esha | 70 | 65 | 60 | 75 | 70
Farhan | 80 | 75 | 85 | 90 | 75

Q. Who has the highest total marks across all five subjects?
explanation: Summing the marks for each student across all five subjects: Amit = 375, Bela = 420, Chetan = 350, Divya = 435, Esha = 340, Farhan = 405. Divya has the highest total of 435. Option B (Bela) is the second highest with 420.
explanation_hi: सभी पांच विषयों में प्रत्येक छात्र के अंकों का योग करने पर: अमित = 375, बेला = 420, चेतन = 350, दिव्या = 435, एशा = 340, फरहान = 405। दिव्या का कुल योग 435 सबसे अधिक है। विकल्प B (बेला) 420 के साथ दूसरा सबसे अधिक है।

question:
Study the table below showing the number of cars sold by five companies (in thousands) over four years and answer the question.

Company | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Maruti | 45 | 50 | 60 | 75
Hyundai | 30 | 35 | 40 | 50
Tata | 20 | 25 | 35 | 50
Mahindra | 15 | 20 | 25 | 30
Honda | 25 | 20 | 15 | 10

Q. What is the total number of cars sold by Tata across all four years?
explanation: To find Tata's total car sales, sum the values for the years 2020 to 2023: 20 + 25 + 35 + 50 = 130 thousand. Option A (120 thousand) is incorrect because it misses the growth in 2023.
explanation_hi: टाटा की कुल कार बिक्री ज्ञात करने के लिए, 2020 से 2023 तक के वर्षों के मूल्यों का योग करें: 20 + 25 + 35 + 50 = 130 हजार। विकल्प A (120 हजार) गलत है क्योंकि यह 2023 की वृद्धि को छोड़ देता है।

question:
Study the table below showing the number of cars sold by five companies (in thousands) over four years and answer the question.

Company | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Maruti | 45 | 50 | 60 | 75
Hyundai | 30 | 35 | 40 | 50
Tata | 20 | 25 | 35 | 50
Mahindra | 15 | 20 | 25 | 30
Honda | 25 | 20 | 15 | 10

Q. Which company experienced a continuous year-on-year decrease in car sales from 2020 to 2023?
explanation: Looking at the trends: Maruti increased (45->50->60->75), Hyundai increased (30->35->40->50), Tata increased (20->25->35->50), Mahindra increased (15->20->25->30), and Honda decreased continuously (25->20->15->10). Thus, Honda is the correct answer. Option A is incorrect as Maruti's sales grew consistently.

question:
Study the table below showing the number of cars sold by five companies (in thousands) over four years and answer the question.

Company | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Maruti | 45 | 50 | 60 | 75
Hyundai | 30 | 35 | 40 | 50
Tata | 20 | 25 | 35 | 50
Mahindra | 15 | 20 | 25 | 30
Honda | 25 | 20 | 15 | 10

Q. For Maruti, what was the percentage growth in car sales from 2020 to 2023?
explanation: Maruti's sales in 2020 were 45 thousand and in 2023 were 75 thousand. Growth = 75 - 45 = 30 thousand. Percentage growth = (30 / 45) * 100 = (2 / 3) * 100 = 66.67%. Option A (50.00%) underestimates the growth rate.

question:
Study the table below showing the number of cars sold by five companies (in thousands) over four years and answer the question.

Company | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Maruti | 45 | 50 | 60 | 75
Hyundai | 30 | 35 | 40 | 50
Tata | 20 | 25 | 35 | 50
Mahindra | 15 | 20 | 25 | 30
Honda | 25 | 20 | 15 | 10

Q. What is the average number of cars sold per company in the year 2022?
explanation: To find the average per company in 2022, sum the sales of all 5 companies in 2022 (60 + 40 + 35 + 25 + 15 = 175 thousand) and divide by 5. 175 / 5 = 35 thousand. Option C (40 thousand) is incorrect as it is higher than the actual average.
explanation_hi: 2022 में प्रति कंपनी औसत ज्ञात करने के लिए, 2022 में सभी 5 कंपनियों की बिक्री का योग करें (60 + 40 + 35 + 25 + 15 = 175 हजार) और 5 से विभाजित करें। 175 / 5 = 35 हजार। विकल्प C (40 हजार) गलत है क्योंकि यह वास्तविक औसत से अधिक है।

question:
Study the table below showing research papers published by five institutions over four years and answer the question.

Institution | 2021 | 2022 | 2023 | 2024
IIT Delhi | 120 | 140 | 160 | 180
IISc Bangalore | 150 | 150 | 170 | 210
JNU Delhi | 80 | 90 | 100 | 110
DU Delhi | 60 | 70 | 70 | 90
BHU Varanasi | 90 | 100 | 120 | 140

Q. What is the percentage increase in research papers published by IIT Delhi from 2021 to 2024?
explanation: IIT Delhi papers in 2021 = 120, and in 2024 = 180. Increase = 180 - 120 = 60. Percentage increase = (60 / 120) * 100 = 50%. Option B (40%) is a miscalculated value resulting from an incorrect denominator or subtraction error.
question_hi:
नीचे दी गई तालिका का अध्ययन करें जिसमें चार वर्षों में पाँच संस्थानों द्वारा प्रकाशित शोध पत्रों को दर्शाया गया है और प्रश्न का उत्तर दें।

संस्थान | 2021 | 2022 | 2023 | 2024
IIT दिल्ली | 120 | 140 | 160 | 180
IISc बैंगलोर | 150 | 150 | 170 | 210
JNU दिल्ली | 80 | 90 | 100 | 110
DU दिल्ली | 60 | 70 | 70 | 90
BHU वाराणसी | 90 | 100 | 120 | 140

प्र. 2021 से 2024 तक IIT दिल्ली द्वारा प्रकाशित शोध पत्रों में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या है?
explanation_hi: 2021 में IIT दिल्ली के पत्र = 120, और 2024 में = 180। वृद्धि = 180 - 120 = 60। प्रतिशत वृद्धि = (60 / 120) * 100 = 50%। विकल्प B (40%) गलत हर या घटाव त्रुटि के परिणामस्वरूप एक गलत गणना किया गया मान है।

question:
Study the table below showing deposits (in ₹ crores) and loans (in ₹ crores) of a bank over five years and answer the question.

Year | Deposits (₹ Cr) | Loans (₹ Cr)
2020 | 5000 | 3500
2021 | 6000 | 5000
2022 | 7500 | 6000
2023 | 9000 | 7500
2024 | 12000 | 10000

Q. What is the average of Loans across the five-year period (2020-2024)?
explanation: Sum of Loans = 3500 + 5000 + 6000 + 7500 + 10000 = 32000. Average = 32000 / 5 = 6400. Option B (6800) is incorrect because it is higher than the actual computed mean.
